name: Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)
advisoryNote: Strong technical baseline. Focus on production-grade testing, continuous integration, and verifiable project proof rather than textbook theory.

name: Information Technology (IT)
advisoryNote: Excellent practical orientation. Strengthen core algorithmic problem solving and distributed systems concepts.

name: Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE)
advisoryNote: Direct bridge to Embedded and IoT engineering. To transition to cloud or software, focus on REST APIs, Linux server environments, and database design.

name: Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE)
advisoryNote: Mathematical rigor translates well to data modeling and physical computing. Focus on modern Python and Git workflows.

name: Mechanical Engineering
advisoryNote: Systematic problem-solving carries over to technical product management and industrial data analytics. Emphasize software fundamentals.

name: Civil Engineering
advisoryNote: Project lifecycle management maps smoothly to business analysis, QA, and geospatial data analytics.

name: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA)
advisoryNote: Applied software focus. Equal footing with engineering graduates when backed by verifiable GitHub deliverables and clean architectural documentation.

name: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
advisoryNote: High eligibility for senior engineering benchmarks. Focus on distributed services, test automation, and system performance benchmarks.

name: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA)
advisoryNote: Combines naturally with data and product pathways. Learning SQL and spreadsheet data pipelines unlocks immediate analytics roles.

name: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
advisoryNote: Strategic decision-making. Pair with technical literacy in APIs, cloud costs, and data pipelines for top-tier product leadership.

name: Bachelor of Commerce (BCom)
advisoryNote: Financial integrity is critical in FinTech, fraud analytics, and business intelligence. SQL and Python data querying open rapid pathways.

name: BSc Computer Science
advisoryNote: Solid theoretical foundation. Bridge the gap to industry standards through automated testing, Git collaboration, and deployment automation.

name: BSc Data Science
advisoryNote: Direct alignment with Data & AI pathways. Ensure equal attention to software engineering standards, modular code, and SQL databases.

name: BSc Statistics / Mathematics
advisoryNote: Rare mathematical depth required for cutting-edge ML and quantitative modeling. Learn modern Python, vectorized pipelines, and reproducible notebooks.

name: BA / Humanities & Social Sciences
advisoryNote: Human-centered perspective is in high demand for UX research, accessible interface design, AI governance, and technical documentation.

name: School: Mathematics / PCM
advisoryNote: Foundational exploration stage. Build computational confidence through basic programming and algorithmic logic before college entrance.

name: School: Biology / PCB
advisoryNote: Opens health informatics, computational biology, and life sciences analytics without engineering entrance requirements.

name: School: PCMB (Maths + Biology)
advisoryNote: Versatile foundation for biomedical technology, bio-data science, or conventional computing tracks.

name: School: Commerce
advisoryNote: Connects directly to business analytics and FinTech. Learn relational database querying (SQL) early.

name: School: Arts / Humanities
advisoryNote: Foundation for digital product design, web accessibility, and technical communications. Begin with semantic HTML/CSS.

name: School: Vocational / Applied
advisoryNote: Project-first learning. Focus on deployable, portfolio-ready web deliverables.
